lane: Mobile: Tarot ritual pacing, spread layout, responsive card size, 4-card share (Owner feedback 17/11 on the Singapore preview APK)
goal: Fix four things the Owner found while testing the Tarot draw on the Android preview build. (1) A 4-card spread produces a share image and link with only 3 cards. (2) Cards flip too fast, so the draw does not feel like a calm ritual focused on the question. (3) Content under the card fan (the extra links and any status) is hard to discover without scrolling. (4) Card size is fixed regardless of screen and card count: a single card is small and leaves empty space below it. Make card and slot size responsive to the measured width and card count.
successCriteria: readingModel, buildShareUrl and shareLinkMessage keep up to 4 cards (the largest spread today); ShareCardView lays out 4 cards without clipping at the 4:5 card size; unit tests cover 1, 3 and 4 cards.
The website share landing accepts up to 4 card ids in code and stays backward compatible with older 1-3 card links; the website itself is NOT deployed here (separate Owner approval).

Flight timing lives in named constants: a longer face-down hold, a slower flip (about 1.5 s), a longer name hold (about 2 s) and a pause between cards; reduced-motion users and the skip control still work; no timer leaks on unmount.
Under the fan the status and error appear above it and the fan, spin controls and the draw links fit above the sticky button on a typical 360x800 phone, checked with adb screenshots.

Slot and flight card width come from one responsive helper (area width and card count): 1 card about 55-60% of the width capped at 220 px, 3 cards about 28%, 4 cards about 22%; no empty gap under a single card; unit tests cover the helper.
npm test, lint and typecheck for apps/mobile pass; a new preview APK built with the Singapore env is installed on the connected phone for the Owner to review.
untouchedSurfaces: No website deploy (apps/web code change only; the Owner runs the deploy).
No SQL, no Edge Function deploy, no secret read or written, no Supabase/Vercel/EAS/Play setting change (the preview build uses the EAS variables already set).
Tarot draw logic, server-drawn cards, quota and Nil rules are unchanged; only presentation, timing and share content change.

managerTestPath: Install the new preview APK, draw 1, 3 and 4 cards: the flip is slower and calm, the share image and link show every card, the card sizes fit the screen and the links under the fan are visible without scrolling.
residualRisk: Pacing and layout are judged by feel and screen size: only the connected phone is tested, other screen sizes are checked through the sizing helper and unit tests, not on real devices. The website landing change needs the Owner's own deploy to take effect for 4-card links.
